notes: Read in full (1446 lines). Archive records (#N) and EA-CORPORA seat designations are not listed as works; seat designations are kept in entries only as the text's own location for an edition. Biblical books are listed one entry each, with the edition where the text names one (Swete LXX; Nestle 1904). Manuscripts the text names as witnesses (Vilna Chronograph, Kirillo-Belozersk 1462, Vat. Urb. 84, Paris suppl. gr. 464, Volokolamsk) are entered as sources. Vague or uncertain: Popov 1866, Sreznevsky 1879, Radenković and Maričić 2018, Morton Smith 1982, Litwa 2016, Miller 1851, Newsom 1985, Yadin 1977, Nöldeke 1886 and Goranson 1998 are named without titles (bracketed descriptions only). Higgins 1990 has no forename in the text. A. Baumgarten's proposed 'revised Josephus' (lines 177, 1386) is named without any work and is not entered. Kottek (line 1366) appears only as the subject of Nöldeke's review. The Suda entry on the Essenes (line 1436) is cited by de Boor, not by the paper, and is not entered. Julius Africanus (line 950) appears only as Syncellus's probable source. Istrin is also named for an explanation recorded by Meshcherskii (line 639) and for texts that left out the Magi story (line 350); no work is specified there, so only his 1920–1922 edition of Slavonic George is entered. Anna Komnene, Cedrenus and Syncellus are named without works. Generic sources not entered: 'the liturgy', 'Orthodox hymnody', 'Rus' chronicles'. The Community Rule's 1951 first publication (line 1392) has no editor named and is not entered. The ChatGPT and DeepSeek reviews are entered because the text quotes and answers them; the author's own quoted statements (e.g. 9 November and 13 November 2026) are not entered as outside works. Leeming 2005 was read in abstract only (paywalled, line 1378); Pichkhadze 2015 is cited from title and reported findings, unread (line 1376); Schmidt 2025 via Pearse's summary (line 1380); quotations of Creed, Zeitlin, Bowman, Cambridge History, Evans, Van Voorst, Meier taken via version 1.0 and Wikipedia (line 1374).
